motion.law: ARTA.md §3: no drawn point of the figure moves more than min(640 px/s·dt, 12 px) per frame, in frame px, camera included

head_gate.rule: no limb sample inside the ring's outer edge (r + stroke/2 = 24 units), samples within 13 units of the neck excluded

exceptions.arrow: a tool, not a drawn point of the figure: 50 world px/frame against a 100 px shaft, so consecutive drawings overlap by half
exceptions.windows: slabs with mass: ease-in 0.55 s, 8 px overshoot, 0.18 s settle — no per-frame ceiling applies

sample_data: fictional (the kit's own Main sample); no photographic or generated people; the seats are empty
